# Fictional clinic intake protocol

Step 1. Confirm the identity of the client.

Step 2. Ask about the reason for the visit, then about medications, then about allergies.

Step 3. If the client reports chest pain, call the duty doctor at once.

An intake takes at most 20 minutes. A follow-up visit must be booked within 14 days after the intake.
